questions.q: What does Minister Milan Krkobabić warn about?
o: That more than 1200 villages in the south of Serbia are on the verge of disappearing
That new factories need to be built
That there are few people in the cities
questions.e: In the video: "upozorava na poraznu demografsku statistiku u selima na jugu Srbije, gde je više od 1200 ruralnih zajednica na pragu gašenja" — warns of devastating demographic statistics in the villages of southern Serbia, where more than 1200 rural communities are on the verge of dying out.

questions.q: How many villages did the National Team choose to save?
questions.e: In the video: "Nacionalni tim za spas sela definisao njih stotinu koja imaju šansu da opstanu" — the National Team for Saving Villages identified a hundred of them that have a chance to survive.

questions.q: What changed with the number of sheep in Pirot over 30 years?
o: There were over 60 thousand, now about 10 thousand
questions.e: In the video: "Grad Pirot je imao preko 60 hiljada ovaca. Mi danas u Pirotu... imamo negde svega oko 10 hiljada ovaca" — the city of Pirot had over 60 thousand sheep. Today in Pirot... we have somewhere around 10 thousand sheep.

questions.q: What is unusual about the plan of the former director of "Tigar"?
o: He brews craft beer, but built production in Pirot, not in the village
questions.e: In the video: "je, na primer, bivši direktor u pirotskom Tigru odlučio da proizvodi zanatsko pivo i prodaje ga isključivo u svom rodnom selu Dojkinci." — for example, the former director at Pirot's Tigar decided to produce craft beer and sell it exclusively in his native village of Dojkinci.

questions.q: What is the main problem for business in the village?
questions.e: In the video: "Jednostavno, najveći problem gore jeste radna snaga" — simply, the biggest problem up there is labor.

o: A stone village with houses built without mortar and roofs of stone slabs
questions.e: In the video: "kameno selo Gostuša, u kome je očuvana gradnja kuća bez vezivnog materijala i sa krovovima od kamenih ploča" — the stone village of Gostuša, where the construction of houses without binding material and with roofs of stone slabs has been preserved.

questions.q: What threatens the look of Gostuša?
o: Locals are replacing stone slabs with red tiles
questions.e: In the video: "umesto kamenih ploča na kućama se crveni crep, što narušava arhitektonsku celinu" — instead of stone slabs, red tiles appear on the houses, which spoils the architectural whole.

o: A festival of the dairy product vurda in Babušnica
questions.e: In the video: "Vurdijadu, manifestaciju posvećenu promociji ovdašnjeg mlečnog specijaliteta" — the Vurdijada, an event dedicated to promoting the local dairy specialty.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.e: Zadruga — a cooperative.
Zamajac — a flywheel; figuratively, a driving force.
Opstati — to survive, to endure.
Pašnjak — a pasture; pasti — to graze.
Crep — a roof tile.

questions.q: Sve veći broj *meštana* obnavlja pradedovska ognjišta.
questions.e: Meštanin — a local resident.
Oklevati — to hesitate, to delay.

questions.q: To bi bio najveći *mamac* za mlade ljude.
questions.e: Mamac — bait, a lure.
Upozoriti na + accusative case: na statistiku.

questions.q: Više od 1200 ruralnih ___ na pragu gašenja.
questions.e: After numbers from 5 the genitive plural is used: zajednica.
After the number 3 the genitive singular is used: pre 3 meseca.
U in answer to "where?" — locative case: u Nišu.
Boriti se sa ("to fight with") requires the instrumental case: sa statistikama.

questions.q: U Pirotu imamo svega oko 10 ___ ovaca.
questions.e: After the number 10 the genitive plural is used: hiljada.

questions.q: Ovce su se spustile u sela pored ___.
questions.e: Pored ("next to") requires the genitive case: pored grada.
Dobiti what — accusative case: nagradu.
